title: Godspell Program Newman Smith High School Carrollton Texas Vintage 1970s Musical
categoryName: Entertainment Memorabilia:Theater Memorabilia:Souvenir Programs:Other Theater Programs
conditionDescription: Complete, clean and unmarked inside. Red cover with light edge wear and light handling marks.
descriptionText:
Vintage souvenir program - Newman Smith High School (Carrollton, Texas) presents GODSPELL, a musical based upon the Gospel according to St. Matthew. Music and new lyrics by Stephen Schwartz, conceived by John-Michael Tebelak. Directed by Mildred A. Peveto. Late 1970s (bios mention a choir piece premiered in 1977).

- Classic red-and-black Godspell clown-face cover
- Director's notes, stage ensemble, musical synopsis for Act I and II, production and student staff, crew, musicians and "Familiar Faces" (waiters and waitresses)
- Photo bios of the cast and directors, plus a costumed cast group photo
- Period local ads: Craft Village, Dan McGee Sporting Goods (Farmers Branch), The Chambers men's wear and Sandee's (Carrollton)

Condition: complete and unmarked inside. Red cover has light edge wear and light handling marks (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
